message.content: {"caption":"Two iterations of an agent workflow show a proposed data-verification skill being created and then used.","description":"A two-stage process diagram. A message trace appears below. In Iteration 1, a question about the arithmetic mean of Total Liabilities is shown alongside a skills directory containing the data-extraction-verification skill and its script. The Base Agent has the skill loaded; its output shows final_answer = 990822.83 and a score of 1.0. A second message trace appears at the bottom.
